tasks.short: Notify auxiliary personnel about plant needs

steps.what: Notify maintenance or auxiliary personnel about malfunctions or required utility adjustments and clarify the need
outputs: shared understanding of required follow up

tasks.design: Keep situational notification and clarification with the operator and responsible auxiliary worker. A message router is not credited with replacing the judgement or conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The operator must explain what has happened and what assistance is needed.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported means removes that responsibility in this task.
tasks.still_hard: Communicate the relevant context without implying an unverified diagnosis.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise urgency and check that the recipient understands the request.
tasks.altitude: Improve the clarity of requests and escalation.

reach.learn: Separate observed symptoms from proposed corrective action

evidence.claim: Plant notification remains a situational professional communication; no labour saving is established.

assumptions: The operator establishes and communicates the need in s1; no free malfunction, urgency or utility adjustment code is assumed.
The auxiliary worker's response occurs during the notification exchange, and the operator's clarification time is retained.
Repair and adjustment execution are outside this task. No new service is deployed and upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Existing escalation arrangements and typical requests
research_questions: Which request ambiguities cause repeated calls?

incremental.description: No added system or operating work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: situational notification and clarification remain fully counted, with zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify material calculation inputs, units and applicable formula version
Calculate material requirements or yields using the verified formula and inputs
Check requirements and yields for plausible inputs and resolve calculation exceptions

tasks.design: Configure locked formulas and visible input provenance in {SPREADSHEET}. The operator verifies applicability and inputs, then checks the calculation; it does not operate equipment or authorise a process change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated formula arithmetic may require manual entry and recomputation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can rerun explicit calculations consistently without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Decide whether the supplied quantities and chosen formula represent the actual process.
tasks.human_edge: Detect a plausible looking answer based on the wrong unit or batch basis.
tasks.altitude: Own calculation inputs and exception handling.

reach.learn: Check formula version and measurement basis

evidence.claim: Explicit material and yield formulas can be configured in native spreadsheet software; the task scenario and savings are unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: The existing batch planning process supplies approved instructions and formulas; existing measurement activities produce readings. No planning or measurement time is claimed as removed.

In s1 the operator captures and checks batch identity, formula version, requested quantity, measured inputs and outputs where relevant, units, time basis and any formula parameters. Retrieval, transcription and missing field clarification are counted in 30 hours.
Formula selection is the operator's decision; no free structured applicability or safe operating flag is assumed.
Missing quantities, incompatible units or inputs outside approved formula limits stop calculation and return to manual review in s3.
Native calculations in the existing system are checked before configuring a workbook. Already automatic calculations yield zero incremental saving.
unknowns: Formula limits and frequency of missing measurements
research_questions: Does configured arithmetic reduce effort after input verification, checks and upkeep?

already_counted.description: Input capture, formula applicability assessment and result checks

incremental.description: Formula upkeep and sampled calculation reconciliation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=55 gives 45 gross and 37 net after 8 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-10 allows existing native calculations and retained field verification; no physical operating time is saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Direct workers operating machinery that regulates material and product flow

tasks.design: Retain operational direction and coordination with the operator. Process dashboards do not replace the responsibility to interpret conditions and direct people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Direction depends on current physical conditions and worker understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: No supplied evidence supports replacing this operational judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinate action as process conditions change.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a mismatch between an instruction and what a worker observes.
tasks.altitude: Improve clarity and escalation during material flow operations.

evidence.claim: Digital logs do not establish replacement of live operational direction; no task labour saving is claimed.

assumptions: The operator obtains and assesses conditions during s1; no structured instruction or safe flow flag is assumed ready.
Workers continue their existing machinery tasks; no work is transferred to them to create a saving.
No deployment or additional monitoring is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Scope of direction and plant communication arrangements
research_questions: Which instructions most often require clarification?

incremental.description: No additional system or operating process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: operational direction remains fully human, giving zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Gauge tank levels with calibrated rods

steps.what: Gauge tank levels using calibrated rods and verify the observed reading

tasks.design: Keep physical rod gauging with the operator. A proposed reporting tool does not produce the physical reading or replace access to the tank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task requires a physical measurement with the specified tool.
tasks.enabler_now: No evidence for replacing rod gauging is supplied.
tasks.still_hard: Obtain a reliable reading under actual tank conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an ambiguous reading or unsuitable measurement condition.

reach.learn: Distinguish an observed level from an inferred value

evidence.claim: Physical calibrated rod gauging is not replaced by digital records; no task labour saving is established.

assumptions: The operator produces the reading during s1; no ready made tank level or calibrated digital sensor is assumed.
Recording the result elsewhere belongs to the recording task and receives no duplicate saving here.
No new equipment or software is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Tank access and current gauging method
research_questions: Which conditions make rod readings unreliable?

incremental.description: No new system or operating work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: physical gauging remains fully counted, with zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Make repeat calculations traceable while preserving plant coordination and physical measurement.
reach: Help supervisors review material balance assumptions and handovers
role.ambitious_version: An operator with fewer repeated calculations and unchanged attention to people, equipment and physical conditions.
